stem: Before surgery, the nurse reviews the client's ASA Physical Status classification. What does this classification primarily describe?

options.A: The technical experience of the surgical and anesthesia teams.
options.B: The insurance authorization category for the procedure.
options.C: The client's preoperative physical health status and severity of systemic disease.
options.D: A complete prediction of postoperative outcome based only on procedure type and duration.

rationale: The ASA Physical Status Classification categorizes a patient's overall preoperative physical health, ranging from a healthy patient to progressively severe systemic disease and moribund status. It is associated with perioperative risk but is not, by itself, a complete outcome-prediction model. C is correct.
educational_objective: Interpret ASA Physical Status as a classification of preoperative physical health and systemic disease burden rather than a stand-alone outcome predictor.

source_original.stem: A nurse reviews a client's ASA Physical Status classification before surgery. What does this classification primarily describe?

options.A: The technical experience of the surgical and anesthesia teams assigned to provide the procedure
options.B: The insurance authorization category used to approve the planned procedure and anesthetic care
options.C: The client's pre-anesthesia physical health status and the burden of systemic disease present
options.D: The predicted surgical outcome based only on procedure type, complexity, and expected duration

source_original.rationale: The ASA Physical Status Classification System communicates the patient's pre-anesthesia physical health and systemic disease burden. It is associated with perioperative risk but is not, by itself, a complete surgical-risk prediction tool.
source_original.source_detail: ASA Physical Status Classification System: classification describes pre-anesthesia physical status/systemic disease burden; accessed 2026-08-14.

correction_summary: The official ASA page was not reliably fetchable during currentness verification, so the final item is anchored to the current NCBI StatPearls summary of the ASA system; retained the correct limitation that ASA PS is not a complete surgical-outcome prediction tool and reduced difficulty to easy.

audit_findings.source_authority: NCBI StatPearls summarizing ASA PS; NCSBN 2026
audit_findings.currentness: NCBI chapter updated 2025-02-11 and included in 2026 edition.
audit_findings.claim_audit: ASA class definitions directly reflect physical status/systemic disease severity; limitations prevent treating it as a complete outcome score.

distractor_audit.D: Overstates scope and uses unrelated procedure-only factors.

audit_findings.ambiguity_second_answer: C uniquely describes the classification construct.
audit_findings.blueprint: Preoperative risk information fits Reduction of Risk Potential.
audit_findings.independent_second_pass: Rechecked current NCBI ASA table/discussion; C remains unique.
